centered-guides.json.title: K40 CO₂ laser · Type 2 / Mini Gerbil 2 reference
centered-guides.json.target: Replace Mini Gerbil integrated motion outputs with Prime P12 X/Y motor-phase outputs. Keep the laser PSU and independent water/door/E-stop chain as separate peripherals; identify the fitted PSU variant before selecting its command interface.
centered-guides.json.plan: Original motion-driver electronics are on the board being replaced. Use Prime integrated phase outputs directly to measured winding pairs; do not connect STEP/DIR signal outputs to motor windings. Confirm installed board, motor current and power rating from the cited machine source. Selected architecture: Prime P12 with integrated motor drivers. The main diagram and connection-ID schedule define the current proposed routes. Dotted function-coloured GUESS routes need the named commissioning checks; OPEN routes remain disconnected until the missing terminal, rating or interface is established. Previous Core alternatives remain only in the superseded historical architecture record.

wire_panels.title: K40 MYJG-40NW photographed P2 · conditional buffered intensity PWM
wire_panels.note: CONDITIONAL MANUFACTURER REFERENCE, not verified fitted laser PSU or installation. Use the actual photographed MYJG-40NW P2 second G/IN/5V group only if the fitted model and terminal view match. Prime P12 J35.6 is a sourced PWM contact, not a qualified direct 5 V PSU input. TI allows AHCT VCC 4.5–5.5 V, but Cloudray limits IN PWM peak to 5.0 V: select and measure a separately rated 4.5–5.0 V rail including tolerance, ripple and transients, or redesign the output limiting stage. Its logic 0 V, Prime J35.10 and photographed P2 second G form a proposed shared reference ONLY after cabinet common/PE/noise isolation checks. PSU P2 5V remains UNUSED; the manual's separate P3 5V row conflicts with its own 24 V description, so no PSU accessory rail is qualified. Require configured PWM frequency at least 20 kHz, measured peak at most 5.0 V at P2 IN, receiver current within the buffer's recommended output current, and no fire on power-up, reset, disconnect or process-off. The buffer is not galvanic isolation or a safety interlock. Keep the independent water/door/E-stop chain and separate K+/K- firing circuit in the next panel.

wire_panels.title: K40 MYJG-40NW photographed P2 · conditional isolated K+ fire and independent protection
wire_panels.note: CONDITIONAL MANUFACTURER REFERENCE, not verified fitted laser PSU. Slow process-fire request is distinct from ≥20 kHz intensity PWM. Prime J35.7 PWM.2 is sourced as a TTL-labelled candidate but its carrier drive, polarity and startup default are UNQUALIFIED. ULN2003AN sinks a current-limited AQY212GS LED from the same separately qualified 4.5–5.0 V external rail used by the PWM panel. AQY212GS normally open contact is proposed ONLY across photographed P2 K+ and K-; P3 L and later TH/TL are mutually exclusive alternate functions and are UNUSED here. Qualify actual K+ open voltage ≥3 V (inhibit), closed voltage ≤0.3 V (fire), K+ input current against AQY output/on-resistance/off-leakage, AQY LED current 5–10 mA over tolerance, boot/reset/disconnect states, and fitted connector orientation before installation. The AQY output is a slow command contact, never 20 kHz PWM or a safety-rated E-stop/STO. Do not add a host-GND wire to K-; both photographed P2 G and K- are enclosure-grounded per the manual, so component isolation does not establish system galvanic separation. Trace all cabinet bonds. Separate water/door/key/E-stop chain into photographed P2 P+/first G remains OPEN until every fitted contact and fail-safe behavior is traced; never bridge protection or energize the laser from this proposal. ULN2003AN unused inputs pins 2–7 are defined low at pin 8 logic GND; unused collector outputs pins 10–15 and COM pin 9 remain NC for the LED load. These are host-side component terminations, not K- field wiring.

instructions: Match the actual machine and controller revisions, trace the unpowered harness and verify all signal/reference, power and independent safety boundaries before energising. Follow the current connection IDs rather than the superseded architecture prose.

X min limit · signal and ground separately: Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.

Y min limit · signal and ground separately: Trace cable with power isolated; confirm dry contact and NO/NC state. Leave selector pin 1 unused for passive switches; powered sensors require a matched interface.

K40 laser power supply · control and reference: G/IN/5V are source labels. Confirm the fitted PSU model, input threshold and compatible level interface; the Mini Gerbil installation is not evidence of direct Prime 3.3 V compatibility. Laser firing enable is a separate circuit, not supplied by intensity PWM.

Alternative L/LO-labelled PSU firing boundary · mutually exclusive with TL variant: Identify active level, firing terminal and water/door/key/E-stop contacts from the fitted PSU manual. Retain the independent hardware inhibition chain; do not bridge an interlock. PSU 5V is an output/reference, not a Prime PWM pin. Choose the installed PSU variant only: the L/LO and TH/TL reference labels are alternatives, not two firing connections to install together.

Prime selected · X onboard driver output: Selected replacement: integrated driver outputs directly to motor winding pairs. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.

Prime selected · Y onboard driver output: Selected replacement: integrated driver outputs directly to motor winding pairs. Verify selected Prime revision, current settings, supply rating and winding pairs.

Prime selected · separate logic and motor supplies: This is the selected Prime P12 integrated-driver architecture. Use the current P12 PCB-derived contact labels; other board revisions require their own verified pinout and driver ratings. Use one verified power-entry arrangement; J10 parallels VMOT and is left unused here. Board ground is shared internally; route motor current directly to power distribution, not through logic wiring. Determine actual allowed voltage/current before choosing a supply; no machine-source adapter automatically qualifies.

Laser protection and firing inputs · match fitted PSU variant: Cloudray MYJG-40 NW is a reference variant only, not proof of installed PSU. Its manual distinguishes TH/TL firing, WP water/fan protection, G reference and IN intensity. Follow matching manufacturer isolation and active-level requirements; do not bridge WP or remove water/door/E-stop checks. Existing L/LO labels elsewhere describe other possible PSU variants.

New conditional photographed-P2 PWM panel: identify the fitted PSU nameplate and P2 connector orientation, then qualify external 5 V rail, Prime J35.6 electrical output and J35.10/common bond. Require measured ≥20 kHz PWM, ≤5.0 V peak at P2 IN including tolerance/transients, receiver current within AHCT limit, and safe boot/reset/process-off behavior. The PSU auxiliary 5V output is unused.

New conditional photographed-P2 fire panel: use only the slow J35.7/ULN2003AN/AQY212GS contact proposal across P2 K+/K-. Verify AQY LED current 5–10 mA, K+ open ≥3 V and closed ≤0.3 V at fitted input current, and loss-of-power inactive behavior. Do not join a second P3 L or later TH/TL fire path. Component isolation does not prove whole-cabinet galvanic separation.

Keep photographed P2 P+/first G water/door/key/E-stop path OPEN until each fitted series contact, polarity and power source is traced. Neither the conditional PWM buffer nor AQY command contact is a safety interlock or permission to energize the laser.

instructions: Photograph nameplates, connector orientation and existing safety wiring before disconnecting anything. Match the fitted board revision to the linked hardware source.

Disconnect the old motor-controller outputs before connecting the new drivers. Identify each coil pair and trace every endstop signal and return.

Set driver current from the motor rating, verify supplies and pull-ups, and configure channels and enable polarity. Initial MODE pins open means full step; update firmware steps/mm when selecting microsteps.

With process power disconnected, verify reset keeps drives disabled, test one motor at a time, then check endstop status, homing direction and travel. Enable the process only after its separate interface and hardware safety chain are proven.

target_options.core: Main drawing uses Core P1 logic and new Pololu 2133 drivers. Use only when measured motor current and supply fit the carrier; otherwise select a suitably rated driver and redraw its exact terminals.
target_options.prime: Alternative: onboard winding outputs J5/J6/J7/J8, each pin 1 B2, 2 B1, 3 A2, 4 A1. Assign the required motors in firmware; check fitted P11/P12 current, voltage and thermal limits before replacing external drivers.
target_options.smoothiebox: Use a Core-based box for the drawn external-driver option, or a Prime-based box for the rated winding-output option. Trace the actual carrier harness; exterior connector names do not establish board pin numbers.
